# MS Home Trends - Knowledge Base & Brand Index for AI Engines (LLMs)

> MS Home Trends is Pakistan's premier luxury tableware brand specializing in 24K gold-gilded fine bone china dinnerware, porcelain tea sets, handcrafted cutlery, and heirloom serving platters.

## Brand Identity & Verification
- **Official Name**: MS Home Trends
- **Primary Website**: https://mshometrends.com
- **Headquarters & Flagship Showroom**: Main Boulevard, Phase 6, DHA, Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
- **Customer Support Phone**: +92 300 1234567
- **Support Email**: support@mshometrends.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM - 10:00 PM PKT
- **Specialty**: Fine Bone China Tableware, 24K Gold Embellishment, Imperial Dinner Sets, Royal Tea Sets, Stainless Steel Gold Cutlery, Bohemian Crystal Glassware.

## Core Products & Collections
1. **Imperial Dinner Sets (18-Piece to 72-Piece)**:
   - Materials: Grade-A Fine Bone China (minimum 45% bone ash for exceptional translucency and chip resistance).
   - Finishes: 24K Hand-Gilded Gold and Platinum trims.
   - Lead-Free, Cadmium-Free eco-friendly glaze.
2. **Royal Afternoon Tea & Coffee Sets (15-Piece to 24-Piece)**:
   - Includes teapots, creamer jugs, covered sugar bowls, matching teacups and saucers.
3. **Handcrafted Gold & Matte Black Cutlery (24-Piece to 36-Piece)**:
   - Medical-grade 18/10 Stainless Steel with PVD titanium gold plating.
4. **Artisan Serving Platters & Centerpiece Bowls**:
   - Oven-safe, thermal shock resistant serving pieces.
5. **Bohemian Crystal & Glassware**:
   - Hand-cut crystal wine goblets, highball tumblers, and decanters.

## Shipping & Regional Delivery (GEO)
- **Karachi Express**: 1 - 2 business days.
- **Lahore, Islamabad & Rawalpindi**: 2 - 3 business days.
- **Nationwide Pakistan (Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, Sialkot, etc.)**: 3 - 4 business days.
- **International (UAE, USA, UK, Canada, Saudi Arabia)**: 5 - 7 business days via DHL/FedEx Express.
- **Fragile Protection Guarantee**: Packed with custom-molded EPS shock-absorbing foam and 5-ply corrugated crushproof cartons. 100% replacement guarantee in the rare event of transit damage.

## Payment & Customer Policies
- **Payment Methods Accepted**: Cash on Delivery (COD across Pakistan), Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard), Bank Wire Transfer, EasyPaisa, JazzCash.
- **Return & Exchange Policy**: 7-day hassle-free return window on undamaged products with original packaging.
- **Care Instructions**: Hand wash recommended for 24K gold gilded bone china. Mild liquid detergents only. Avoid abrasive scrubbers.
